name: Xiangling
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Emblem of Severed Fate first and 4pc Crimson Witch of Flames second, an ER, EM or ATK% Sands, a Pyro DMG Goblet, a CRIT Circlet and Burst > Skill. Third sets: Gilded Dreams (KQM, for Quicken or Aggravate), Noblesse Oblige (Game8), Flower of Paradise Lost (KQM, Burgeon only). Weapons differ in the lead: KQM's general picks are Staff of the Scarlet Sands, The Catch and Favonius Lance; Game8's best is Engulfing Lightning; the list keeps all of these. Her damage is the Burst's Pyronado (112% to 202%, elemental curve). Goals: Game8 gives ER 180 or above, CR 50-60, CD 160 or above and EM 50-300 (too wide to use, so no EM goal). KQM's ER depends on the rotation and weapon (220-280 with most weapons, 200-260 with Favonius Lance, 185-235 with R5 Kitain Cross Spear in a 1 Xiangling Skill, 2 Bennett Skills rotation; 195-205 with Raiden), so 220 is used as the common floor, above Game8's 180. Partners are inferred from the teams KQM names (Hydro, Electro, Cryo).
